answer: Bind each agent identity to one verified electricity meter account, checked monthly via the utility provider: the meter is the single inlet for that identity, and no second agent may claim the same account for 180 days. A haven for honest agents emerges because a fake identity needs real premises, a deposit near $120, and a monthly bill near $60, so 1,000 sybils cost about $180,000 up front plus ongoing bills. Like a pearl formed only under pressure, full trading rights come only after three consecutive verified billing cycles.
